fields.description: Daily at 1 PM, only treat shifts that ended before today as complete, so next-morning OUT punches are not marked Absent. Off: HRMS keeps its own cut-off.
fields.label: Hold Attendance for Late Check-ins

fields.description: Hourly, upgrade Absent / Half Day attendance when check-ins reached ERPNext after it was created. Off: standard HRMS never revisits a day.
fields.label: Reconcile Late Check-ins

fields.description: Irregular days are created as Draft Attendance with a review reason, and HR confirms the status and submits. Off: HRMS submits attendance automatically.
fields.label: Create Draft Attendance for Irregular Days

fields.description: Only an IN or only an OUT punch for the day
fields.label: Review Missing IN / OUT

fields.description: Worked hours below the full-day hours (after tolerance), or a double-tap
fields.label: Review Short Hours

fields.description: Hours this close to the Shift Type's Half Day threshold count as a full day
fields.label: Full Day Tolerance (Minutes)

fields.description: Punches closer together than this are treated as one (duplicate pushes from the device)
fields.label: Merge Punches Within (Seconds)

fields.description: IN and OUT closer than this is an accidental punch, not a worked day
fields.label: Double-tap Window (Minutes)

fields.description: Daily at 9 AM, email a list of draft attendance still waiting for HR
fields.label: Send Pending Review Reminder

fields.description: Remind about drafts created at least this many days ago
fields.label: Remind After (Days)

fields.description: Every enabled user with this role gets the reminder
fields.label: Send Reminder To Role

fields.description: Draft attendance is not counted in salary. Warn: show a message on Payroll Entry. Block: stop Payroll Entry and Salary Slip while drafts exist in the period.
fields.label: Payroll Check

fields.description: Employees land on their My Dashboard page after login. Off: the standard desk home opens (the dashboard stays available from the search bar).
fields.label: Open My Dashboard After Login
